policy.publicReleaseRule: A public release may include only a provider record whose publicAllowed is true and only the provider's publicFields. Derived data from a restricted provider remains private until a written redistribution right is recorded.
policy.rawSnapshotRule: Every capture has a checksum, fetch time, parser version, source URI, publication scope, and rights classification. OAuth tokens, secrets, manager names, and private chat are never snapshots.
policy.sharedProviderRule: Global football inputs may be consumed by approved publications. League truth and recommendation runs are publication-scoped and never join across leagues.

providers.activation: Yahoo OAuth approval and league discovery
providers.credentialBoundary: OAuth credentials and refresh tokens remain local; they are never sent to GCS, BigQuery, generated releases, or frontend bundles.

providers.reason: Redistribution review required before provider-derived fields enter a public release.

providers.activation: Licensed endpoint and written usage confirmation
providers.reason: Free prototype access is non-production and cannot feed the public site.

providers.reason: RSS metadata only; do not scrape or store article bodies or subscriber analysis.
A generation service, not a data source. It receives only source-bound facts and does not use web grounding; private chat is never persisted or published.
Existing FantasyPros ECR, RotoBaller, Justin Boone/Yahoo Sports, and DraftSharks snapshots remain reproducibility artifacts, not live adapters or public-release inputs.
